subject: [MAP] ACME POC - environment setup dependencies (VPC/SAML/KMS/IP allowlist)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acme.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: [MAP] ACME POC - environment setup dependencies (VPC/SAML/KMS/IP allowlist)

Hi Jordan / team,

Thanks again for the call today — appreciate the clarity on success criteria. Attached is a first-pass MAP milestone sheet (acme-map-milestone-v1.xlsx) and a short summary of the POC environment dependencies we discussed. My goal here is to lock down owners and target dates so we can kick off the provisioning window next week.

POC environment setup (milestone: Env Dependencies complete) — asks and owners:
- VPC peering / routing: ACME infra to create a peering request and share the peer ID and route table changes. Owner: ACME infra (Samantha). Target: 2026-08-27.
- IP allowlists (egress/ingress): ACME network to confirm public egress IPs / CIDRs to permit (we will provide Redwood ingress ranges). Owner: ACME infra. Target: 2026-08-24.
- SSO / SAML: We need IdP metadata or a SAML metadata URL and an SP EntityID to configure SCIM/SAML. Owner: ACME SSO team. Target: 2026-08-25.
- Secrets / KMS: For Private deployment, ACME will provision a customer-managed KMS key alias and grant Redwood service principal decrypt/encrypt permissions. Owner: ACME security. Target: 2026-08-27.

Dependencies / notes:
- For VPC peering we need the peer account ID and allowed CIDRs to set route entries. If you prefer VPC endpoints + NAT rather than peering we can support that — let us know.
- For IP allowlist please share both IPv4 ranges and any static NAT IPs used for egress — we will add to our firewall and return a final allowlist to you for verification.
- For SSO we support Okta/OneLogin/ADFS; if you can share IdP metadata we can pre-populate the Redwood Console and reduce test iterations.
- For KMS we will perform a short review of key policies; we only need a key alias and a minimal Grant to our service account.

Next steps: please confirm owners and attach the network diagram (or give access to the diagram link) and any contact for the ACME infra Slack channel. I've put a short checklist in the MAP doc (link below).

MAP doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcDeFgHIjK-map-MAP-v1
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567

Attachments: acme-map-milestone-v1.xlsx

Thanks,
Marissa
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0199
From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Cho <s.cho@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: [MAP] ACME POC - environment setup dependencies (VPC/SAML/KMS/IP allowlist)

Marissa — thanks for the recap and the MAP. Appreciate the breakdown. Quick responses below and I've looped in Samantha (our infra lead) to own the network items.

- VPC peering: Samantha will raise the peering request today. Our AWS account ID is 987654321012 and primary VPC CIDR is 10.12.0.0/16. We plan to have routes updated by 08/26.
- IP allowlist: Our egress will be NATed to a pair of Elastic IPs: 3.45.67.89 and 3.45.67.90. Confirm which Redwood ingress ranges you need and we'll add them.
- SSO/SAML: Okta tenant; I can provide a SAML metadata URL. Will send it to you and Samantha by EOD 08/21.
- KMS: We will create an alias alias/ACME/redwood-poc and attach a key policy granting the Redwood service principal. Samantha will coordinate with our security team.

We're aligned on the MAP milestones broadly — target for env dependencies complete by 08/27 looks ok assuming peering and allowlists are processed this week. On the call, you mentioned you might need a CIDR for Egress — please send the exact CIDRs and ports.

Thanks,
Jordan
Director, Platform Engineering | Acme Corp
j.ellis@acme.com
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Samantha Cho <s.cho@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: [MAP] ACME POC - environment setup dependencies (VPC/SAML/KMS/IP allowlist)

Thanks Marissa / Jordan — looping in a short internal checklist from the infra side so ACME has visibility on what we'll need to configure.

Redwood infra checklist (technical points / owner notes):
- VPC peering: We will need the peer ID and the exact route table IDs for the subnets that will reach the Redwood endpoints. If you prefer security groups on endpoints vs. full route tables we can document that. Also let us know whether peering is cross-account (looks like it is from the account ID Jordan shared).
- IP allowlist: Please add these Redwood ingress IPs to your allowlist: 18.144.22.10/32, 18.144.22.11/32 (these are for the POC). Ports: 443 outbound (TLS). If you need a broader CIDR for egress testing let us know and we can provide ranges.
- SAML: For fastest setup provide IdP metadata XML or metadata URL plus a test user (okta username) so we can validate SSO during provisioning. Our SP EntityID: urn:redwood:sp:poc. Also indicate whether you require SP-initiated vs IdP-initiated flows.
- KMS/Secrets: For customer-managed key please create alias/ACME/redwood-poc and add a Grant for the Redwood service principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-poc (we will provide the exact ARN once account-level approval is done). We only require Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey permissions for the POC.

Attachments: network-diagram.png (I attached a sample mapping of the routes we expect).

Estimate to get env dependencies in our side configured once we have the peering and SAML metadata: 2 business days to provision and validate. If everything is submitted by 08/24 we can aim for full POC readiness by 08/27.

Cheers,
Nikhil
Principal Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference
ikhil.sharma@redwood.com

Perfect — thanks everyone for the quick responses and for owning items. I've updated the MAP doc with the owner names and the target dates you confirmed.

Next actions:
- Jordan / Samantha: please share the peering request ID + route table IDs and the Okta metadata URL by EOD 08/21.
- ACME Security: create alias/ACME/redwood-poc and confirm Grant to our service role (we'll provide the ARN by EOD 08/21).
- Redwood (Nikhil): will provision endpoints and test SAML once metadata + test user are provided.

Target milestone: Env dependencies complete by 2026-08-27. If anything blocks, flag here and we'll escalate. I'll schedule a 30-min sync Monday 08/24 to confirm progress — invite will land shortly.
